name: enter_chain_function
description: Defines a function that processes a message and a list of team members, returning a structured result.

name: results_variable
description: Initializes a dictionary to store messages and team members.

name: messages_assignment
description: Adds a key to the results dictionary that contains a list of HumanMessage objects initialized with the provided message.

name: team_members_assignment
description: Adds a key to the results dictionary that contains a string of team members joined by commas.

name: return_statement
description: Returns the results dictionary from the enter_chain function.

name: authoring_chain_variable
description: Initializes the authoring_chain variable to hold a functional composition of the enter_chain function and the authoring_graph compilation.

name: partial_function_call
description: Creates a partial function of enter_chain with the members argument set to the nodes of the authoring_graph.

name: compile_method_call
description: Calls the compile method on the authoring_graph to prepare it for use in the authoring_chain.
